title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach rituals and recurring campus celebrations, from a paintable Spirit Rock to aviation-themed contests.

cards.title: Leave a message on the Spirit Rock
cards.subtitle: Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach campus
cards.notes: Reserve a painting slot, follow the posted content guidelines, and use the rock to share a respectful school-spirit message.
cards.short_summary: A campus-sanctioned, student-painted forum for spirit and expression.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle identifies the Spirit Rock as a valued Daytona Beach campus tradition and provides student painting guidelines.
cards.access_notes: Use the Spirit Rock registration and guidelines on the university CampusGroups page before painting.

cards.title: Join the Orientation Class Photo
cards.subtitle: New Student Orientation, Daytona Beach
cards.notes: Find your class-year image after orientation, download the high-resolution file, and keep it as a record of joining the Eagle community.
cards.short_summary: An annual first-year group portrait preserved across graduating classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Daytona Beach Orientation office calls its annual official Orientation Class Photo a tradition connecting students, parents and alumni.
cards.source_title: Class Photo | New Student Orientation, Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Orientation programming is for participating new students; past class photos are available to view and download online.

cards.title: Show up for Blue & Gold Week
cards.subtitle: Annual Daytona Beach spirit week
cards.notes: Check the current schedule, choose a few campus events, and use the week as a practical way to take part in Blue and Gold pride.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s Daytona Beach Blue & Gold Week page describes a campus spirit week celebrating university spirit and student passions.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Dates, locations and registration details vary by year; consult the current Blue & Gold Week schedule.

cards.title: Make the Blue & Gold Carnival your anchor event
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold Week, Columbia Lot
cards.notes: Use the Blue & Gold Week schedule to confirm the carnival date and location, then build your visit around the larger spirit-week program.
cards.short_summary: A named carnival that opens Blue & Gold Week’s celebratory rhythm.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Blue & Gold Week schedule lists the Blue & Gold Carnival as a featured campus event in Columbia Lot.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Confirm annual timing and event entry details through the Blue & Gold Week schedule.

cards.title: Watch or enter Pull-A-Plane
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold Week, AMS Ramp
cards.notes: Look for team and participation details in the current Blue & Gold Week listings, then head to the AMS Ramp at the scheduled time.
cards.short_summary: An aviation-specific strength challenge staged during spirit week.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s 2026 Blue & Gold Week schedule lists Pull-A-Plane at the AMS Ramp.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Participation rules and scheduling are event-specific; verify them with the current Blue & Gold Week listing.

cards.title: Add color at the Chalk Art Contest
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold Week, Legacy Walk
cards.notes: Bring your creativity to Legacy Walk during the posted contest window, and check the event listing for any entry or material requirements.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled campus-art ritual set along Legacy Walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Blue & Gold Week schedule lists a Chalk Art Contest on Legacy Walk, sponsored by Student Engagement and the Student Union.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Consult the current schedule for the contest time, registration and participation instructions.

cards.title: Gather at the Blue & Gold Block Party
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold Week, Connolly Quad
cards.notes: Use the annual schedule to verify the theme and timing, then meet at Connolly Quad for this Student Government Association program.
cards.short_summary: A named spirit-week gathering in the campus quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s 2026 Blue & Gold Week schedule lists a Blue & Gold Block Party at Connolly Quad, sponsored by Student Government Association.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Themes and timing change by year; verify the current Blue & Gold Week schedule before attending.

cards.title: Come back for Homecoming & Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach campus
cards.notes: Register when the annual event opens, then use the released schedule to select campus tours, athletics and community programs that fit your visit.
cards.short_summary: An annual return-to-campus gathering connecting students, families and alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle says Daytona Beach Homecoming & Family Weekend occurs each year and connects students, alumni, parents and families through campus events.
cards.source_title: Current Eagle Parents | Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University
cards.access_notes: Registration and programming are annual; the 2026 event is scheduled for October 2-3 on the Daytona Beach campus.

cards.title: See the Homecoming Fly-In and static display
cards.subtitle: Homecoming & Family Weekend, Daytona Beach campus
cards.notes: Watch the Homecoming schedule for flight-line access details, then include the fly-in and static-display visit in your weekend itinerary.
cards.short_summary: An aviation-centered Homecoming activity built around aircraft on display.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s 2026 Homecoming & Family Weekend page lists participating in the fly-in and touring the static display among prior event highlights.
cards.source_title: Homecoming and Family Weekend 2026 | Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University
cards.access_notes: Listed as a previous Homecoming highlight; confirm whether it returns and review flight-line access instructions for the current year.

cards.title: Make time for Discovery Day
cards.subtitle: Annual student research symposium, Daytona Beach
cards.notes: Browse the virtual exhibit for previous years, then watch university research announcements for the next chance to see student work presented.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus showcase of student, faculty and staff research and creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s Discovery Day exhibit describes an annual Daytona Beach Student Research Symposium and archives programs from 2015 through 2025.
cards.access_notes: The exhibit documents prior symposium years; consult the Office of Undergraduate Research for the next event’s presentation details.
